text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s07","problem":"The hero photo is still a blurry, soft-focus stand-in. The real screen has sharp white and yellow wildflowers on green moss under a crisp glass sphere with a bright top highlight and rainbow edge. This is the largest heatmap error (SSIM 0.729). No picture is listed for s07, so it must be drawn in CSS.","fix":"Rebuild the hero in y0-480 without blur. Use a flat gray-blue #6b6f75 sky. Add many small sharp white (#f4f4f0) and yellow (#d9a83a) flower dots in 3-8px sizes over a dark green (#4a5a35 to #2f4a2a) moss band from y290 to y480. Keep the sphere at about x112-298, y122-315, with a 1px light rim, a bright white radial highlight at the top and a dark green reflection on the lower-left. Fade the bottom into #fcfbf9 over the last 20px."},{"element_id":"s07","problem":"The title 'Welcome to Computer' is bigger and wider than the real one. The mock runs x124-287, the real x128-283. The subtitle wraps differently: the real one breaks after 'Computer, your' at x30-381, the mock after 'Computer,'.","fix":"Reduce the title font-size by about 3% to 4% and tighten its letter-spacing by about -0.5px, so the line widths are about 155px and 135px. Shrink the subtitle to about 14.5px and set the container width to about 352px, so the break falls after 'Computer,' as in the real screen, with 'your' starting line 2. Keep the text centered."},{"element_id":"s04","problem":"The row 'Hand off complex tasks and get polished results' stays on one line and runs to x381. The real screen wraps it onto two lines, ending 'polished' / 'results' at about x336. Text also renders slightly heavier and wider elsewhere, including the heading and the composer text.","fix":"Set the text column max-width to about 270px, so the row wraps after 'polished' with 'results' on the second line at y596. Keep the row's icon and dividers where they are. Reduce the heading letter-spacing slightly, so it spans x53-359. Set the composer text to font-weight 400 and 1px narrower."},{"element_id":"s04","problem":"The 'Get started' label and the 'Computer' chip text in the composer are bolder and offset by 1-2px from the real ones.","fix":"Set the 'Get started' label to weight 500 and 16px. Shift the chip's 'Computer' text and icon left by about 1px, and use weight 500 at 13px."},{"element_id":"s01","problem":"The 'Ask anything…' placeholder renders wider than the real one, and the search icon in the tab is drawn slightly thicker. The incognito icon at the right of the composer also differs.","fix":"Narrow the placeholder by about 2px with letter-spacing -0.1px, at 15px weight 400 in #77736d. Use a 1.6px stroke on the search icon. Redraw the incognito glasses icon as an outline with a hat brim, 20px wide, at x278-296."},{"element_id":"s10","problem":"The 'Set up Computer' banner title is bolder and wider, and it crowds the '0/3' counter. The 'Do anything…' placeholder also renders wider, and the incognito icon differs.","fix":"Set the banner title to weight 500 at 14.5px, so it ends about 6px before '0/3'. Add a 4px margin before the counter. Narrow the 'Do anything…' placeholder by about 2px, and draw the incognito icon as a thin-stroke outline."}],"summary":"All tagged elements are in place and no taps or contracts fail, so what remains is visual fidelity. The biggest gap is the s07 hero photo, which is blurry instead of sharp flowers and a crisp glass sphere, followed by text width and weight and line-wrap differences on s04 and s07. Small text and icon tweaks on s01 and s10 finish the round."}
